resources.string: Keep what matters. Clear the rest.
Early development. KeepClear can\'t look at or delete anything yet.
Junk you won\'t miss, cleaned in one tap. Everything waits 30 days in the trash.
Things that might matter, explained in plain words. You decide.
Your memories go to your own drive and are checked before anything is deleted.
No ads. No tracking. No internet access.
